faq: Is the invoice generator really free?
Yes. No trial, no limits on the number of invoices, no account.
Do the invoices meet EU rules?
They include what EU invoices need, including sequential numbers, VAT per rate, both parties’ details and reverse-charge wording for EU business clients. Check special cases with your accountant.
Can I make credit notes?
Yes. One click turns an invoice into a credit note with its own number, ready to adjust.
Can I invoice in Dutch?
Yes. Choose English or Dutch per business, or per client.
